description:
## Why
443 #[test]s live inline in 45 production modules (e.g. types/arrow_match.rs 83, pull.rs 44, runtime_type_predicate.rs 41); the house rule is sibling <module>_test.rs files mounted with #[path].

## What changes
Each module's inline tests move to its sibling _test.rs file.

## Signal
No #[test] outside *_test.rs files.
title: Move inline #[test]s out of production modules
